ownership.quote: Hetzner Online GmbH began operations in Germany in 1997 under the name Hetzner Online Services... The company is named after its founder Martin Hetzner.

stage.quote: Hetzner Online GmbH began operations in Germany in 1997... Between 2000 and 2015, Hetzner Online in Germany operated under the legal status AG. In 2015, it changed its legal status to GmbH.
stage.note: Privately-held, founder-named German hosting company operating since 1997 with no known external venture funding rounds found; treated as bootstrapped, not a startup with priced rounds.

note: Hetzner is a long-established (since 1997), founder-owned German bare-metal/cloud hosting company (data centers in Germany, Finland, US, Singapore), not a VC-backed startup. No accelerator participation, funding rounds, or investors were found. It should be scored as a profitable/self-funded private company rather than unknown-stage, though exact revenue and employee counts could not be confirmed from public sources within the research window.
